title: JESUS, THE GOOD SHEPHERD OF YOUR SOULS
theme: Jesus provides for, protects, seeks, and ultimately separates His sheep, calling wandering souls to return and follow His voice.
proposition: We must hear and obey the Good Shepherd, who rescues our souls and leads His sheep to life.
sermonQuestion: How does Jesus care for our souls as the Good Shepherd, and how should we respond?
